Adoptable Cat of the Week

By Quinn White · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

Mocha is a 6-year-old Siamese mix who knows how to make herself at home. Although she’s guarded in new situations, when she’s relaxed, you might find her snoozing in a lap or accepting belly rubs. When she wants to play, you’ll love watching her pounce after her favorite wand toys, zoom through her tunnel, and tackle her tiny toy caterpillar.

That playful streak can occasionally get ahead of her manners: Mocha can switch quickly from cuddling to play mode, and may grab or swat at nearby hands. So she’ll do well with an adopter who has enough experience with cats to notice when to preemptively redirect her energy. She prefers to be the only cat in her kingdom, and takes daily anxiety medication to help her feel her best.

Give her the boundaries she craves, and the playtime she adores, and you’ll have a clever, affectionate companion who greets you at the door with little meows, rubs against your legs, and sleeps on your chest. Her foster sums her up simply: “She’s such a beautiful, sweet girl.”

Mocha is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and FeLV/FIV negative. Learn more at www.cattownoakland.org or email adopt@cat-townoakland.org to ask about meeting her!
